sections.title: Remove thread ownership pre-check from run-creation endpoints
sections.rationale: All four hunks delete the same duplicated `existing_thread` ownership guard (and its now-unused ThreadORM import) from the create/stream/wait run endpoints, so they are one access-control concern.
